description: This file defines the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementModel class, which is a PHP model used in the OrangeHRM system to represent an employee's leave entitlement details. It implements serialization and constructor argument interfaces, providing a method to convert the model data to an array for API responses, encapsulating employee information and leave entitlements.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementModel
classes.description: A PHP model class used for representing and serializing an employee's leave entitlement data in the OrangeHRM system, including employee details and entitlement calculations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementModel with employee info, leave entitlements, and optional entitlement value.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model's data into an associative array suitable for API responses, calculating current entitlement from the provided leave entitlements.
